requirements.title: General Physics
requirements.summary: PHYSICS 135-1 may be replaced by PHYSICS 125-1, PHYSICS 140-1 or GEN_ENG 212-0. These substitute courses still need individual metadata records.

requirements.title: Remaining 26-unit core categories
requirements.summary: The core includes four mathematics courses, four basic-science units, three engineering foundations courses, three design/communications/innovation courses, seven social sciences/humanities courses and five unrestricted electives. Three additional science units and the school-wide approved pools remain to be expanded.

requirements.title: Choose an alternative for Software Design & Composition
requirements.summary: Complete one listed course or course bundle for this slot.

requirements.title: Four advanced electives
requirements.summary: Choose four advanced electives. Any course at level 300 or above is eligible, along with the introductory supporting courses explicitly listed in the catalog. The introductory exceptions are not yet fully mapped; this open pool must not be interpreted as a finite inventory.

requirements.title: Five of six breadth domains
requirements.summary: Select five distinct domains and complete one listed course in each selected domain.

requirements.title: Degree-wide requirements remain applicable
requirements.summary: The 48-unit degree consists of a 26-unit core and a 22-unit major. Students must also meet the Undergraduate Registration Requirement and home-school degree requirements. Full school and university policy mapping remains pending.
